# Remotion Markup

The main Remotion markup guidance: how to write content, animation and effects in Remotion React code — frame-driven animation with useCurrentFrame() and interpolate() instead of CSS animations, media components, the built-in effects catalogue, compositions, timing, transitions, fonts, images, GIFs, Lottie, FFmpeg and silence detection, voiceover, and preserving the user's own edits — backed by 33 topic reference files, and with the complete Remotion Maps skill embedded as a subfolder. It works in the user's own Remotion project; packages are added at use time with npx remotion add, and its optional voiceover guide can use the user's own ElevenLabs key if they choose that TTS provider. No licence was found anywhere in the upstream repository at the pinned commit — see the licence note on this listing.
